newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Pick hits high on CEO's remarks.
newsitem.headline: Pick hits high on CEO's remarks.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian meat processor Pick Szeged jumped to an all-time high of 15,350 forints on Thursday, a few minutes before the close, reacting to the CEO's indication of higher first half sales and profits, traders said.
"Our first half figures fulfil our plans," Pick's CEO Vilmos Bihari told Reuters.
Asked whether this meant increased profits, Bihari said the company would have better profits margins than in the first half of 1996.
A trader said news about Pick increased demand for the paper while its supply side remained weak.
